items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: This is, this is, this is part of the Walter, the great Walter Bounds. That's part of his picture.

ctx.x: How many years were you with the Rabbit Foot about? Well altogether I worked with the Rabbit Foot Show 14 years. 14? That's how long. I've seen a lot of other musicians come and go I guess.
Yeah. 14 years. This is, this is, this is part of the Walter, the great Walter Bounds. That's part of his picture. Oh yeah, the one's the fella died in the Natchez fire. Yeah, it was terrible.
